note: Room hazards drawn in code on the floor. A mission room opts in with "hazards": [{"type": "<ID>", "count": n}]; the battlefield places them on open floor away from spawns and cover. They hit robots as well as operators and ignore cover.

ARC_VENT.title: ARC VENT
ARC_VENT.tip: ARC VENT: a grate crackles for a second before it discharges; step off it. Robots standing on it take the hit too.

SPORE_CLOUD.title: SPORE CLOUD
SPORE_CLOUD.tip: SPORE CLOUD: spores gather before a lingering cloud hurts operators and robots; leave the green floor ring.

FROST_PLATE.title: FROST PLATE
FROST_PLATE.tip: FROST PLATE: this pale floor slows operators and robots without damaging them; keep your route off the frost.

RAIL_LANE.title: RAIL LANE
RAIL_LANE.tip: RAIL LANE: the long rail lights up before it discharges; sidestep the narrow band. Robots are hit too.
